topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: Ongoing fees or expenses are charges you pay regularly, such as an annual account maintenance fee, even if there are no transactions in your account.
question: Misconception: “If I don’t make any trades, my brokerage account can’t charge me fees.”
answer: Not necessarily. Some brokerage fees are ongoing rather than tied to buying or selling. For example, an account may have an annual maintenance fee, and brokerage firms may also charge fees for inactivity or other account services. Check the fee schedule and account disclosures to understand which fees may apply.
